2. It aims to digitise and catalogue over 1 crore manuscripts.
3. It does not use AI or OCR technologies.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It integrates AI, Optical Character Recognition and blockchain for access, transcription and provenance. It builds on the National Mission for Manuscripts.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the Gyan Bharatam National Manuscript Survey, consider the following statements:
1. It aims to create a geo-tagged national inventory of manuscript repositories.
2. It will build a national 'Manuscript Presence Map'.
3. Article 51A(f) of the Constitution makes it a fundamental duty to value and preserve the heritage of our composite culture.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Bakhshali Manuscript has early discussions of zero, and the Rigveda Samhita is recognised by UNESCO.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the Sahitya Akademi, consider the following statements:
1. It is India's National Academy of Letters, an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture.
2. It was formally established in 1952 and inaugurated on 12 March 1954.
3. The Sahitya Akademi Awards 2025 were announced in 24 Indian languages.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Navtej Sarna won for the English novel Crimson Spring and Mamta Kalia for the Hindi memoir Jeete Jee Allahabad.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to the World Happiness Report 2026, consider the following statements:
1. India fell from 116th in 2025 to 118th in 2026.
2. It is published by the Wellbeing Research Centre of the University of Oxford with Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network.
3. Finland retained the top rank for the ninth consecutive year.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: India rose from 118th in 2025 to 116th in 2026. Nepal ranks 99th and Pakistan 104th, and happiness is measured on the Cantril Ladder of 0 to 10.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to ideas of happiness, consider the following statements:
1. The Taittiriya Upanishad describes Brahman as Sat-Chit-Ananda.
2. Aristotle's Eudaimonia means a flourishing life through virtue and rational activity.
3. Bhutan coined the idea of Gross National Happiness.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Delhi Happiness Curriculum, launched in 2018, reaches nearly 8 lakh students daily and UNESCO has a 'Happy Schools' framework.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to ethics in AI use for national security, consider the following statements:
1. Utilitarianism supports use of AI in defence for the greatest security benefit to the majority.
2. Black-box AI systems help to fix legal and moral responsibility easily.
3. A deontological stance refuses to cross certain ethical boundaries regardless of benefits.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Black-box systems lack transparency, which makes it difficult to attribute responsibility if a system errs or violates humanitarian law. India has a Defence AI Council and a Defence AI Project Agency.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM), consider the following statements:
1. The Cabinet approved the extension of the Mission till December 2028.
2. It aims at Functional Household Tap Connection to every rural household with 55 litres per capita per day.
3. It is a Central Sector Scheme launched in 2019.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Ministry of Jal Shakti launched in 2019. Tap water coverage rose from 3.23 crore households (16.7%) in 2019 to 15.83 crore (about 81.8%) in 2026.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the institutions under the Jal Jeevan Mission, consider the following statements:
1. Paani Samitis operate and maintain the village water supply system.
2. At least 50% of members of Paani Samitis must be women.
3. A Village Action Plan covers drinking water sources, grey water reuse, supply systems and operation and maintenance.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. At least five women per village are trained to test water using Field Test Kits, and Nal Jal Mitras are trained villagers who repair piped schemes.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The Functionality Assessment of 2024 under the Jal Jeevan Mission found that what share of tap connections were functional?
questions.why: 98.1% of households in surveyed villages had tap connections, 84% received water as per schedule, 80% received at least 55 LPCD and 76% of connections were functional.
